groups.instruction: What is the main attraction in each of the following areas of the festival? Choose FIVE answers from the box and write the correct letter, A-G, next to questions 11-15.
Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.text: What does Sam say about the festival tickets?

options.t: They allow you to get into all the festival events.
They are more expensive to buy on the day.
They have nearly all been sold.

questions.text: On the last night of the festival, visitors will be able to
What will be provided for international visitors?

options.t: a guide written in different languages

questions.text: What information is given about car park A?

options.t: It is bigger than car park B.
It is closer to town than car park B.
It will close earlier than car park B.

questions.text: What change have the organisers made to the programme this year?

options.t: replacing the programme with an app
reducing the number of programmes printed
introducing a charge for the programmes
